system.description:
Know this simple spell and you’ll never be without that which you need. Starting with a scrap, piece or fragment, the wizard can recreate and multiply wood, rope, cloth or paper.

Obstacle: 3^. Actions: 12.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Single Target, Paces | Element: Earth | Impetus: Create | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 12

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 216
